title: Fix Frontend Admin Principal Check and Diagnostics

requirements.summary: Update frontend admin check hook to use correct hardcoded principal, normalize comparisons, and add diagnostic console logging
acceptanceCriteria: The hardcoded fallback string in useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout is exactly 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae'.
Principal comparisons use .trim().toLowerCase() on both the caller principal and the hardcoded value.
Browser console logs print the caller principal, fallback principal, and backend isCallerAdmin result during each admin check.
Admin button and Admin Dashboard are accessible for the principal 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae' on the live site.

file_operations.description: Update the hardcoded fallback admin principal to exactly 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae'. Modify all principal comparison logic to use .trim().toLowerCase() on both sides. Add comprehensive console.log statements that output: (1) the current caller's principal text, (2) the hardcoded fallback principal, (3) the backend isCallerAdmin call result, and (4) the final computed admin status. Ensure these logs fire during each admin check phase (immediate fallback check and backend verification).
